issue.title: [I08/U22/B63] Reconcile saves and publish confirmations
issue.body:
<!-- graphgoblin-delivery:2026-11-14 -->
**Current delivery — engineering complete, owner acceptance pending:** [PR #475](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/475) merged on 2026-11-15 UTC as `41bde22c80a796bf8c4bec8ab5dec8e755271f9e`. The reviewed head was `30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348`, tree `6cdf7c4369ae3494bafddaa6f9f83cf9335f2029`, against actual main `8fadcb0d`. Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh implemented and corrected the UI. GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh's first adversarial scan required four fixes; fresh GPT-6 Astra max [final whole-PR scan 2 signed off](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/475#issuecomment-6887049928), with all four resolved and no new actionable findings. Two of three scan slots were used.

All five current-target CI jobs passed first attempt: [CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43657427543) and [routing](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43657427557). Coverage passed 22 tasks, including web 2,598 tests/210 files and domain 459/29. Browser passed 479 plus one expected live-provider skip, with zero retries; Windows launcher passed 14/14. The configured high audit threshold passed with eight low and thirteen moderate advisories.

Independent compiled-gateway/file-SQLite/Edge native QA passed all 19 outcomes across 14 isolated fixtures on first execution, with no driver corrections or page errors. Exact API/device definitions, tokens, immutable versions, request chronology, source/maps/1,227 built files, served bytes and cleanup were verified. The tested ancestor's product/test/build inputs are unchanged through the reviewed head. [Final native evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348/docs/qa/2026-11-14-publish-final-main-native/README.md). Original negative schedules, first findings, formatter failures and canceled earlier CI remain retained; none substitutes for current gates.

**Owner acceptance remains open.** This record is parked from further implementation while awaiting the owner's observations of the merged build. No update to the owner's running instance or subjective acceptance is claimed here. Record the actual build and assess saved/published/later-edit wording, clarity of the available recovery copies, and trustworthy navigation/list updates before closing #237. Machine-verifiable engineering criteria below are complete.
<!-- /graphgoblin-delivery:2026-11-14 -->

<!-- graphgoblin-routing:2026-11-14 -->
**Owner routing update (2026-11-14):** Claude owns UI design and implementation; GPT independently adversarially reviews it. This issue routes to Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh implementation and GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh review, with separate behavior QA and the preserved fresh Astra max exact-head audit. Earlier GPT frontend proposals are unaccepted inputs for Claude to assess and own, not completed UI delivery. Model tier/effort stays proportional to each slice; smaller independent implementation work is delegated to faster agents. The older proposed routing below is historical.
<!-- /graphgoblin-routing:2026-11-14 -->

Part of #311

<!-- graphgoblin-dispatch:2026-11-13 -->
**Current dispatch (2026-11-13):** Released for I08, the first lane, alongside the Claude plugin. The [new scoped authorization](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/279#issuecomment-6872558885) supersedes older implementation holds below for this bounded work only. Preserve independent review, QA, exact-head audit, conditional reproduction and explicit owner closure requirements. Historical plan and evidence follow.
<!-- /graphgoblin-dispatch:2026-11-13 -->

<!-- graphgoblin-approved-roadmap:2026-10-17:B63 -->

<!-- graphgoblin-approved-revision:2026-10-18 -->

**Owner-approved consolidated revision, 2026-10-18. Implementation remains held by #279.** Latest owner decisions in #278 supersede older proposals and historical comments. This approval authorizes backlog publication only; no implementation, owner-environment change, or provider run is dispatched.

Authority and complete owner decision record: #278. Current text supersedes older model proposals and historical scheduling/approval statements; comments remain historical evidence, not a competing current specification.

## Bounded change

Reconcile saves and publish confirmations

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Held saves/navigation cannot leave the list falsely stale; publish success refers to the exact stored revision and never implies newer unsaved edits were published.

- [x] Verify save/list/publish revision reconciliation with delayed/held responses, including refusal paths; an old response must not replace a newer authored or published state.

## Verification

Controlled delayed responses plus real browser navigation/edit/publish; failed save/conflict cases remain explicit.

## Dependencies

- #281 — X-EDITOR
- #279 — implementation dispatch remains held.

## Scope limits

Only the described behavior and its necessary tests/contracts/docs.

## Delivery and closure

Approved plan; parked pending explicit dispatch. Proposed implementer: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh; independent reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh; independent QA: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh. QA scope: touched systems, including relevant positive, negative, concurrency, cancellation and restart cases. All tests use supported interfaces; retain existing coverage protections.

**Owner product acceptance required before closure.** PRs use Part of rather than auto-closing this issue until the owner has accepted the running behavior.

No implementation gate labels are applied now. After later dispatch, select the repository gate consistent with owner-review requirements; never combine aidlc-ready and human-in-the-loop.

## Source requirements

#156, #237

## Evidence provenance (not a new test result)

The observations below describe their original assessed baseline. They are not current solution requirements; the approved scope above controls. Reproduce on the accepted target before relying on them.

### Source #237 — historical evidence

Source links: [source 1](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/c379f806ba8a04433779d98ded7e4196c9d4b663/apps/web/src/editor/EditorPage.tsx#L191), [source 2](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/c379f806ba8a04433779d98ded7e4196c9d4b663/apps/web/src/editor/EditorToolbar.tsx#L131)


## Consolidated source reports

- #156: Loop list can retain stale name and description after a saved draft edit.

These reports are closed as duplicate tracking records. Their accepted requirements and owner-review conditions remain in this bolt. This bolt is the sole open delivery record; no implementation or acceptance is claimed by consolidation.
